Paragraph: His speech, generated in three places, is enthralling; whose heart is not enchanted by it, even that of an enemy with a raised sword?
Situation/Problem_Faced: Rama marvels at the persuasive, disarming power of Hanuman's speech, capable of softening even hostility.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Recognizes speech as a powerful tool that can defuse conflict and anger.
Outcome/Resolution: Cements Rama's high regard for Hanuman's character and skill.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Anger Management: De-escalating hostility even in an armed enemy

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Vak-siddhi (perfected, potent speech capable of transforming hearts)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Hanuman's vak-siddhi, mastery of speech, exemplifies the transformative, disarming power of truthful, well-formed words.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Illustrates the conflict-de-escalating potential of skilled, genuine communication, capable of softening even anger and hostility.
